what more can he do? In your youth you honor your father and take from him what he teaches you. As a man, you, too, add to this knowledge, and your own son will add even more.

@@U00264@@
That man is happy who has any hope of rising out of this sea of confusion! What we need most is just what we don’t have, and what we have is of no use whatever. Ah, but why spoil the beauty of this blessed moment with such melancholy thoughts? Look there! Do you see? Cottages nestled in their beds of greenery, shimmering in the rays of the setting sun. The sun retreats, moves on, and day is done, scurrying off to nourish new life elsewhere. Oh, how I wish for wings to lift me from earth and strive forever after him! Below me the world in eternal sunset, peaks flaring in the glow, valleys tucked in slumber, and silver brooks flowing into golden streams. No savage mountain, no gorges then could check my godlike flight. And there, look! The ocean and its sun-warmed bays opening out to my wondering eyes! At last the god seems near to sinking, and a new impulse wakens in my breast: I hurry after to drink his eternal light, the day before me, and behind me the night, above me the heavens, and below me the waves.

他还能做什么呢？在你年轻的时候，你尊敬你的父亲，并从他那里学到他教给你的东西。作为一个男人，你也可以增加这些知识，你自己的儿子也会增加更多。

@@U00264@@
有希望走出这片迷茫之海的人是幸福的！我们最需要的正是我们所没有的，而我们拥有的却毫无用处。啊，但是为什么要用如此忧郁的想法来破坏这幸福时刻的美丽呢？看那儿！你看到了吗？小屋依偎在绿树丛中，在夕阳的照射下闪闪发光。太阳退去，继续前行，白昼结束，匆匆离开去滋养别处的新生命。哦，我多么希望有翅膀将我带离地球，并永远追随他！在我脚下，世界处于永恒的日落之中，山峰在霞光中闪耀，山谷沉睡，银色的溪流汇入金色的溪流。那时，没有任何荒山、峡谷能够阻止我神一般的飞行。在那里，看！海洋和阳光温暖的海湾展现在我好奇的眼前！最后，神似乎快要沉没了，一种新的冲动在我的胸中苏醒：我赶紧去喝他永恒的光，在我前面是白天，在我后面是黑夜，在我上面是天堂，在我下面是波浪。
